resources.string: Sign in to your Stricknani to bring your projects and yarns onto this phone.

Scheduled backups run automatically and include your live Stricknani sign-in token. Without a password, every scheduled backup is a plain, readable file - and the destination folder you pick is often synced to the cloud. Set a password to encrypt scheduled backups, or continue without one.
